basis.claim: SAP's pack carries substantive documented fundamentals: 2025 revenue of EUR36,800m with operating margin improving to 26.1% and free cash flow nearly doubling to EUR8.24bn.
Cloud growth plus capital returns support the subject: cloud revenue up 23% to EUR21,023m, a completed EUR5bn buyback and a new EUR10bn program to 2027, with net cash on the balance sheet.
The main negative in SAP's own evidence is the pronounced slowdown in current cloud backlog growth to 25% from 29% at constant currencies, alongside declining license and support revenue.
The comparable pack is essentially empty of fundamentals: no drafted thesis, no evidence records and no figures landed for ANET, so nothing supports it as the better pick.

The two are only loosely comparable — same sector and size band but different industry group (SAP software vs ANET hardware) at rung 2 — which tempers the comparison.
